entries.title: Venus
sourceAnchors: Venus / The Empress
The planets in your natal chart represent different aspects of your personality: Venus as love, beauty, relationships
Venus identifies desire
sourceNotes: Venus shows what someone values, what they choose, what attracts them, and how desire becomes relational.
The Empress correspondence frames Venus through beauty, growth, nourishment, embodiment, and the natural cycles that shape connection.
In house material, Venus is tied to how desire is managed, how relationships begin and end, and what someone treats as worth choosing.
voiceMoves: Write Venus through concrete choices, desire, value, taste, attachment, beauty, and what someone keeps returning to.
Name what the person is evaluating before they open, choose, invest, merge, or stay.
avoid: Do not reduce Venus to romance only.
Do not repeat the word trust as the center of every sentence.
Do not make Venus sugary, passive, or generically feminine.

entries.title: Saturn
sourceAnchors: Saturn / The World
Saturn as maturity, responsibility, the process of growing up
Saturn helps progressive ideas focus and come into form
sourceNotes: Saturn names the part of life that asks for responsibility, structure, consequence, time, and completion.
The World correspondence frames Saturn as the discipline that brings something into form and closes cycles when they are complete.
Saturn should not be written only as punishment. It is the pressure that asks whether something can become real.
voiceMoves: Use Saturn for terms, limits, time, structure, responsibility, proof, pressure, and what has to be carried.
When Saturn rules a sign or house, ask what must become concrete instead of staying abstract.
avoid: Do not write Saturn as generic hardship.
Do not make every Saturn sentence about fear.

entries.title: Capricorn
sourceAnchors: Capricorn / The Devil
10th House - Capricorn: The Devil
The Devil/Capricorn represents the false belief of being trapped in current circumstances
Saturn / The World
sourceNotes: Capricorn shows where life is organized by consequence, responsibility, public reality, ambition, and what has to be built over time.
The Devil correspondence is not just temptation. It points to the moment someone mistakes a structure, obligation, role, or fear for a permanent prison.
Capricorn can expose the terms of a situation: what is owed, what is binding, what is chosen, and what only looks unavoidable.
Because Saturn rules Capricorn, the sign asks whether desire, ambition, or attachment can survive contact with reality.
voiceMoves: Write Capricorn as the architecture around desire: terms, proof, cost, role, consequence, timing, and what becomes real through repeated choices.
Make the tension specific: what does the person think they have to accept, carry, earn, prove, or endure?
avoid: Do not flatten Capricorn into loyalty, hard work, or ambition only.
Do not say 'love becomes real through consistency' unless you name what consistency is protecting or requiring.
Do not overuse duty, trust, stability, or commitment as vague center words.

entries.title: Aquarius
sourceAnchors: Aquarius - I innovate, I disrupt, I organize the collective
Aquarius / The Star
The Star brings strength and free flow of energy to inspire large groups of people
Saturn can help Aquarius focus progressive ideas and bring them to fruition
Uranus brings rebellion, revolution, change, risk, innovation, and boundary-breaking
sourceNotes: Aquarius hears the signal of the collective: the group, the platform, the future, the system, the movement, and what people are being asked to agree to.
The Star correspondence gives Aquarius a frequency image: hope, inspiration, future vision, and a current that can move through groups.
Aquarius is not difference for its own sake. It asks which ideas organize people, which ideas limit them, and which ones make room for another future.
voiceMoves: Use the language of frequency, tuning, systems, groups, platforms, shared ideals, and agreements.
Ask what everyone is being asked to accept before they understand it.
avoid: Do not reduce Aquarius to quirky, detached, rebellious, or humanitarian.
Do not circle the word truth. Name the agreement, system, or future being questioned.

entries.title: Scorpio
sourceAnchors: Scorpio / Death
Death as the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth
Scorpio as transformation, power, desire, emotional depth, shared resources, sexuality, and secrets
sourceNotes: Scorpio marks the places where desire, power, secrecy, shared energy, endings, and renewal cannot be kept superficial.
The Death correspondence is about the threshold where an old arrangement has to be released because the deeper reality has changed.
Scorpio asks what is hidden underneath the bond, transaction, fear, or attachment.
voiceMoves: Use Scorpio to name the underlayer: what is shared, concealed, merged, feared, owed, desired, or ready to end.
Let the writing feel precise and unsentimental, not dramatic.
avoid: Do not make Scorpio only intensity, jealousy, or transformation.
Do not use transformation as a vague end point. Name what changes.

entries.title: 8th House
sourceAnchors: 8th House - Scorpio: Death
The eighth house is the house of other people's money, death, joint resources, sex, and secrets
The 8th house corresponds to cycles of birth, death, and rebirth
The 8th house can represent rebranding, relaunching, or transformation
sourceNotes: The 8th house is where a person meets what is shared, owed, merged, inherited, hidden, feared, desired, or changed by contact with another person or system.

This house is not only intimacy. It includes shared money, debts, joint resources, secrets, endings, sexuality, symbolic language, and the part of life that changes because something has been exposed.
The Death correspondence makes the 8th house a threshold: something old is released, not because it is poetic, but because the terms of life have changed.
voiceMoves: Write the 8th house through access, exposure, shared resources, private consequences, emotional cost, debts, desire, inheritance, and what cannot stay hidden.
Ask what happens after someone or something gets access.
avoid: Do not make every 8th-house sentence about trust.
Do not use transformation without naming what is being exchanged, exposed, ended, merged, or carried.

entries.title: 9th House
sourceAnchors: 9th House - Sagittarius: Temperance
The ninth house is related to higher education, foreign travel, wisdom, philosophy, expansion, and higher thinking
Temperance guides balance between the mundane and spiritual worlds, passion and reason
sourceNotes: The 9th house shows how a person forms a worldview through learning, philosophy, spiritual language, travel, education, and the attempt to understand larger systems.
Temperance makes the 9th house less about collecting beliefs and more about testing how ideas combine: reason with passion, spiritual with practical, inherited teaching with lived experience.
This house asks what a person is agreeing to, studying, teaching, or trying to make meaningful.
voiceMoves: Write the 9th house through belief systems, schools of thought, doctrine, education, spiritual language, and the meaning a person is asked to organize life around.
Be specific about what is being questioned or learned.
avoid: Do not overuse truth, expansion, purpose, or wisdom.
Do not write the 9th house as passive studying.

entries.title: 10th House
sourceAnchors: 10th House - Capricorn: The Devil
The tenth house is the house of career, reputation, public image, ambition, and how you are known in the world
The 10th house is where one stands tall, rooted in the center of their being but aspiring towards ascension
sourceNotes: The 10th house shows the public architecture of a life: reputation, responsibility, career, visibility, ambition, and the role someone becomes known for.
Through Capricorn and The Devil, it can also show where public success comes with terms, temptation, confinement, or the belief that a role cannot be changed.
The 10th house asks what a person is building in the world and what that public structure asks from them.
voiceMoves: Write the 10th house through role, reputation, public consequence, visible responsibility, professional proof, and what the world recognizes.
Name the structure around ambition, not just the ambition itself.
avoid: Do not reduce the 10th house to career only.
Do not use success language without naming the role or cost.
